comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Now blocking, not just tidying. Two features on `rad-sprint` need grammar commits that are not in v0.6.0: the signed operand after `??`/`catch` (649637a) and the literal brace (1e41475). Until v0.6.1 ships and go.mod moves onto it, those cases only pass with a local `replace` directive pointing at ~/src/tree-sitter-rad, so CI on this branch will be red.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Released as **v0.7.0**, not v0.6.1. Both unreleased grammar commits are `feat:` - the signed operand after `??`/`catch` (649637a) and the literal brace (1e41475) - so a minor bump is the right semver read.

`rad-sprint` is on it (`chore: move onto tree-sitter-rad v0.7.0`), the local `replace` directives are gone from all six worktrees, and the full suite is green without them.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Blocks 9d180293 on branch rad-sprint1 (`x ?? -1` parses). That commit is landed but its two snapshot cases fail against tree-sitter-rad v0.6.0, because the grammar rule they exercise is committed upstream but unreleased.

**Upstream state** (`~/src/tree-sitter-rad`, `main`, unpushed):

- `4e554f2` chore: regenerate checked-in artifacts - NODES.md/FIELDS.md had been stale since ac743bd (missing the `group` field), plus tree-sitter runtime headers from CLI 0.23.2. Split out deliberately so the next commit reads clean.
- `649637a` feat: allow a signed operand after ?? and catch - the actual change.

**To land:**

1. Push and release from `~/src/tree-sitter-rad` (`./dev -r 1` for a patch bump).
2. `go mod edit -dropreplace github.com/amterp/tree-sitter-rad` in rad, then bump the require to v0.6.1.
3. `cd bindings/go && go clean -cache` before rebuilding - cgo does not reliably pick up a regenerated `parser.c` otherwise, which is why `./dev` does this. Without it the grammar change appears to have silently not worked.
4. `go test ./...` - the two cases in control_flow/fallback.snap and catch_expr.snap should pass.

**Watch out for:** a local `replace` directive is currently in rad's go.mod, unstaged. `./dev --release` refuses to release with one present, so drop it rather than committing it.

Also: `stash@{0}` in `~/src/tree-sitter-rad` holds in-progress nested/sub-command grammar work (a_25Rcu72Hl). It predates these two commits and touches `grammar.js` in a different rule, so the source will merge, but the generated `parser.c` will conflict hard. Resolve `grammar.js` by hand and re-run `./dev -b` rather than merging generated files.
title: Release tree-sitter-rad v0.6.1 and bump rad onto it
